## Description {#details}

<p>Base class for a JIT linker.</p>


<p>A <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/jitlink/jitlinkerbase">JITLinkerBase</a> instance links one object file into an ongoing JIT session. <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/jitlink/symbol">Symbol</a> resolution and finalization operations are pluggable, and called using continuation passing (passing a continuation for the remaining linker work) to allow them to be performed asynchronously.</p>


<p>Definition at line 29 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/executionengine/lib/executionengine/jitlink/jitlinkgeneric-h">JITLinkGeneric.h</a>.</p>
